$comment: Creative dial set for Travafa content generation. Code reads this to pick a valid, non-repeating combination; the chosen dials are injected into the LLM user prompt. Values are written in cinematographer language on purpose — prompt_text goes into the media prompt, id goes into the database.
status: draft — pending review, not yet validated against real generations

locked_constants.$comment: NOT dials. These never vary and belong in the system prompt.
locked_constants.logo_overlay: Travafa logo is composited after generation into the top-left safe zone. Never rendered by the video model.
locked_constants.end_card: A 3 second end card with the Travafa logo and a book-now line is composited after generation. Never described in a scene prompt.
locked_constants.brand_name_spoken: The brand name may be spoken aloud in the final scene. It is never rendered as text or a logo by the video model.

app_visual_language.$comment: Sampled from real app screenshots in assets/app/. Describes colour and shape only. Never describe screen CONTENT - naming what a screen says makes the model render unreadable text.
app_visual_language.surfaces: white cards, generous corner radius, soft shadow
app_visual_language.contrast: near-black rounded pills for selected state
app_visual_language.shapes: everything rounded - full pill buttons, floating pill navigation bar, pastel-tinted rounded icon tiles

locked_constants.video_resolution: 720p - gives 4s, 6s and 8s scene lengths, which the beat plan needs. 1080p allows only 8s.

on_screen_text.$comment: Composited after generation with the same machinery as the logo and end card. The video model never renders text.
on_screen_text.position: centre of the frame, inside the Reels safe zone
on_screen_text.safe_zone: nothing critical in the top 14% or bottom 20% - platform UI covers those
on_screen_text.style: large high-contrast sans, white with a soft dark scrim behind, no paragraphs
on_screen_text.rule: every beat's meaning must survive with the sound off

voiceover_track.$comment: One continuous narration generated by TTS, laid under the whole reel. Not spoken by anyone in frame.
voiceover_track.rule: the narration carries across cuts; it is what makes six fast beats read as one film

locked_constants.$comment_structure: Story structure, pacing and beat count now live in veo-prompt-template.md. This file holds only what varies between posts.

change_rule.secondary_dials: free, subject only to their own cooldown
change_rule.$comment: Counted against the 5 primary dials that survive: time_of_day, subject_focus, human_presence, product_focus, payoff_scene.
change_rule.$comment_cooldown: A dial's cooldown must be at most values-1, otherwise excluding the recent window leaves nothing to pick and the rule silently stops applying.

throttles.reason: Models default to golden hour. Cooldown alone still leaves it over-represented.

human_presence.$comment: Every value must be able to speak on camera: the template requires dialogue from the first seconds. `none` and `hands_only` were removed because they cannot.

copy_tone.$comment: Weighted pick. aspirational is the brand default voice, not one option among four.

dials.$comment_weights: A dial may carry a `weights` map of value id -> relative weight. Absent means uniform. Weights apply after cooldown, throttle and compatibility filtering.
dials.$comment_requires_facts: A dial value may carry `requires_facts: true`, meaning it cannot be honoured without verified figures in the input. The picker must exclude such values when no facts are supplied, otherwise the model is forced to invent numbers.

product_focus.$comment: Which of Travafa's four approved features (BRAND table in veo-prompt-template.md) this post proves. Chosen by code, not by the model - left to itself the model kept picking 'AI trip planner' for every topic, so the other three features never got airtime. cooldown 3 with 4 values forces genuine rotation: excluding the last 3 posts always leaves exactly one open.

values.prompt_text: AI trip planner
Group trip planning
Booking in the plan
Shared coordination

product_presence.$comment: The phone is the hero prop. Every post shows the product being used; only the manner varies. Feeds PhoneShotAction, not PRODUCT_FOCUS - it describes how the phone is held and used, not which feature the video is about.

values.prompt_text: holds the phone naturally and uses the app in front of them
the screen itself is the beat - comparing, confirming, sharing - held steady and angled to camera
the app behaviour happens physically alongside the phone: a group deciding together, or a past trip being revisited through photos

payoff_scene.$comment: Beat 5. Generated, and deliberately a different place from beats 1-3 - the cut to somewhere else is the payoff.

in the window seat as the wing catches the light
stepping out into the destination for the first time, luggage in hand
settled into the destination, unhurried, the trip clearly under way
leaving home with a packed bag, the trip beginning

dials.$comment_feeds: Each dial names the brief field it flows into. LOOK_CONSTRAINTS, CREATIVE_ANGLE and CAPTION are composite fields - every dial that feeds one of these three is joined into a single 'name: text; name: text' string. Any other feeds target (PRODUCT_FOCUS, PHONE_SHOT_ACTION) is a direct passthrough: exactly one dial should feed it, and its prompt_text becomes that brief field verbatim.

incompatibilities.$comment: Pairs that must never co-occur. Format 'dial:value'. Symmetric — order does not matter.
